title: conventions-reviewer return
description: The conventions-reviewer's return object on either axis. The reviewer writes no file, so this object is the only carrier of its findings.

oneOf.description: A pass: document dispatch was reviewed.

outcome.description: The document axis was reviewed; names the axis, never a judgement.

document_path.description: The absolute path of the document reviewed.

findings.description: One item per finding; omitted when there is none.

items.description: One finding against the reviewed document.

evidence.description: The file and the symbol or quoted substring that contradicts it, never a line coordinate.

oneOf.description: A pass: corpus dispatch was reviewed.

outcome.description: The corpus axis was reviewed; names the axis, never a judgement.

findings.description: One item per finding; omitted when there is none.

items.description: One finding, naming the member its correction lands in and the check it fires under.

document_path.description: The corpus member the correction lands in.

check_id.description: C1-C6 for a corpus check, or a document-pass check number for a finding against the target: project member.

evidence.description: The sibling document and a quoted anchor in it, never a line coordinate.

outcome.description: A missing dispatch value, a re-dispatch for an already-reviewed document, or a corpus dispatch with an out-of-range iteration.
